title: Senior AI Solution Evangelist
description:
Our Why
  
At Datacom, we partner with organisations and communities across Australia and New Zealand to make a real difference in people's lives. We empower our clients to innovate and grow by harnessing the true power of technology.
  
About the Role
  
Are you passionate about the transformative power of AI? Do you thrive at the intersection of deep technical knowledge and customer enablement?
  
As our Senior AI Solution Evangelist, you will be the technical driving force behind the Datacom AI Sandpit—a strategic collaboration between Dell, Red Hat, and Datacom. Your mission is to ignite interest, build a strong sales pipeline, and empower our clients to develop their in\-house AI capabilities using this powerful platform.
  
You will engage with a diverse customer base, from mid\-sized businesses to large enterprises (150 to 60,000\+ seats) across critical sectors like Health, Transport, Finance, and Government. This is your opportunity to become a trusted advisor, guiding organisations on their AI journey from concept to reality.
  
Our offices are based in Sydney and Melbourne. We like to bring people together in person when we can, but we are mindful of the benefits of working from home for work/ life balance. We therefore leave it to you and the team you join to figure out what works best!
  
What You'll Do
  
This role blends hands\-on technical expertise with strategic customer engagement. While your infrastructure background is crucial, your passion for AI is what will make you successful. You will:
  
* Lead the Technical Pre\-Sales Cycle: Drive the technical discovery, solution design, and delivery of compelling demonstrations for the Datacom AI Sandpit.
* Architect \& Deploy Solutions: Build and implement proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions within the AI Sandpit, showcasing tangible business value for our clients.
* Educate \& Enable: Design and deliver engaging workshops and training sessions to upskill clients, empowering them to leverage the full potential of the AI platform.
* Create High\-Quality Documentation: Author clear and comprehensive technical documents, including High\-Level Designs (HLDs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and formal proposals.
* Drive Pipeline Growth: Collaborate closely with the sales team to identify, qualify, and win new opportunities.
* Be a Voice for the AI Sandpit at Datacom: Act as a thought leader and evangelist, presenting at industry events, webinars, and customer forums to build excitement around Datacom's AI capabilities.


We are a pretty agile company, and are keen to respond to customer, technology and internal stakeholders’ changing requirements and this can mean we evolve in our roles to meet those needs.
  
What You'll Bring
  
We are seeking a technical expert with a gift for communication and a drive to help customers succeed. You should have:
  
* Strong Technical Foundations: A solid background in IT infrastructure (servers, storage, networking) combined with hands\-on experience in a software\-defined environment, particularly with Linux and container technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift).
* Passion for AI: A solid understanding of AI/ML concepts and the AI lifecycle. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you must have a genuine passion and a strong desire to deepen your expertise.
* Customer\-Facing Experience: Proven success in a role such as a Pre\-sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Consultant.
* Exceptional Communication Skills: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Technical Training Expertise: Proven experience in designing, creating, and delivering technical training material. A significant part of this role will be updating course content and developing associated hands\-on lab work.
* Documentation Excellence: A demonstrable history of creating high\-quality, professional technical and commercial documentation (SOWs, HLDs, proposals).
* Advantageous Certifications: Industry\-recognised certifications in enterprise architecture (e.g., TOGAF) or container platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift, Nutanix, nVidia NCA\-AIIO and/or NCA\-AII) will be looked upon favorably.


Why join us here at Datacom?
  
Datacom is one of Australia and New Zealand’s largest suppliers of Information Technology professional services. We have managed to maintain a dynamic, agile, small business feel that is often diluted in larger organisations of our size. It's our people that give Datacom its unique culture and energy that you can feel from the moment you meet with us.
  
We care about our people and provide a range of perks such as social events, chill\-out spaces, remote working, flexi\-hours and professional development courses to name a few. You’ll have the opportunity to learn, develop your career, connect and bring your true self to work. You will be recognised and valued for your contributions and be able to do your work in a collegial, flat\-structured environment.
  
We operate at the forefront of technology to help Australia and New Zealand’s largest enterprise organisations explore possibilities and solve their greatest challenges, so you will never run out of interesting new challenges and opportunities.
  
We want Datacom to be an inclusive and welcoming workplace for everyone and take pride in the steps we have taken and continue to take to make our environment fun and friendly, and our people feel supported.

**AEMO at the Heart of Energy**
 AEMO is Australia’s independent energy system and market operator and system planner. AEMO’s purpose is to ensure safe, reliable and affordable energy today, and enable the energy transition for the benefit of all Australians. Australian governments are now committed to a net zero economy for Australia by 2050 and our vision is to enable this. We have the once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to co\-design the future of our energy systems, and our core values revolve around character, commitment, and connection. Join us as we contribute to this significant transition in the energy sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our team’s bread and butter are the engineering apps and real\-time analytics tools that help the control rooms make sense of the firehose of instreaming data, by combining and visualising many different data sources intelligently. The AEMO control rooms monitor and operate the electricity grids and gas grids 24/7\. With AI trending relentlessly, and the integration of renewables providing a steady stream of challenges to solve, there has never been a more exciting time to be in the thick of it.
   

  

 The role entails working on projects and BAU initiatives, ranging from data preparation to full scale machine learning solutions. You will design, build, train, compare, evaluate, deploy and document, using the state\-of\-the\-art advancements of the past decade. Some initiatives will involve other software developers and product team members. Some initiatives might be solo and autonomous. You will always work directly with the end users and SMEs. Most of the time the end users will be electrical engineers and analysts in Operations, i.e. a highly technical audience.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Write robust Python code for novel machine learning use cases and match the most appropriate machine learning approaches to engineering problems and take the lead in brain\-storming sessions.
* Set the bar and guide junior team members to follow best practices for ML.
* Create and maintain meta data for Operations data sources in the data catalogue and data virtualisation environments.
* Take ownership of sharable artifacts such as graph database of the electricity grid assets and instigate knowledge sharing sessions with the Analytics User Group.
* Shadow the PSA Technical Lead as second\-in\-command for ITIL Service Management processes like IT Change Management.


**What Will You Bring To The Role**
 We’re looking for someone who has grappled with the idiosyncrasies of many ML projects and who proudly wears the scars. Someone who stands their ground when inundated with hairy maths and dense academic papers, because their curiosity and excitement to solve problems always wins out. Someone who likes to collaborate, mentor, and exchange knowledge, and who is totally comfortable admitting when they don’t know. An ability to sync up with the team’s subtle but quirky sense of humour would be a bonus (fireship). Plus the ability to shrug off the inevitable hurdles with a bit of tongue\-in\-cheek mockery, then quietly forging ahead. relish the opportunity to take an initiative from inception all the way through to production deployment and support.
   

  

 Your experience includes
   

  

* Successful ML projects that are running in production.
* Many of the ML Python libraries such as Jax, Scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Wandb etc.
* Data cleansing, normalisation, one\-hot encoding, and text embedding.
* Understanding graph data and time\-series, and shaping them for ML models
* Deploying models, working with data pipelines, supporting production systems.
* Wrangling hardware drivers and config to offload matrix computations to GPU / TPU / NPU.


 At any stage a candidate may be asked to complete a data science challenge.
   

  

 If your resume mentions any showcase activities, for example on Kaggle, it will be taken into account.
   

  

**Benefits**
**In return some of our benefits to you**
* Flexible working: work from home, part time, job share, hybrid options, and additional leave options
* Professional development via projects, industry networks, job rotation, study assistance and more.
* Give back with up to 4 days of volunteering leave per year.
* Reward your hard work with annual performance bonuses (subject to eligibility).
* Embrace a healthier you with our wellness program, discounted health insurance, gym perks and our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

 At AEMO we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome people of all backgrounds, including people with disabilities and neurodivergence and those who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. **About Binance Accelerator Program**Binance Accelerator Program is a concise fixed\-term program designed for Early Career Talent to have an immersive experience in the rapidly expanding Web3 space. You will be given the opportunity to experience life at Binance and understand what goes on behind the scenes of the worlds’ leading blockchain ecosystem. Alongside your job, there will also be a focus on networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career.Learn about BAP Program**HERE**.

Current university students and recent graduates.

* **ETL Support:** Assist with data extraction, transformation, and loading to ensure reliable and accurate datasets.
* **Database Management:** Write, optimise, and troubleshoot SQL queries; work with relational and non\-relational databases.
* **Data Analysis \& Insights:** Explore and analyse datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
* **Reporting \& Visualisation:** Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Excel, Datawind Dashboard, Tableau, or Power BI.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with analysts, data scientists, and engineers on cross\-functional projects.
* **Documentation \& Best Practice:** Contribute to process documentation, data dictionaries, and continuous improvement initiatives.

### **Requirements**

* Currently studying towards a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and experience with at least one database management system (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MongoDB).
* Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Excel, Python (pandas, NumPy), or R.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Detail\-oriented, organised, and able to manage multiple priorities.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands\-on experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Datawind Dashboard).
* Previous internship, coursework, or project work in data analysis, data engineering, or machine learning.
* Understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing concepts, or cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

**Why Binance*** Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
* Collaborate with world\-class talent in a user\-centric global organization with a flat structure
* Tackle unique, fast\-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
* Thrive in a results\-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
* Competitive salary and company benefits
* Work\-from\-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

title: AI Quality Assurance Lead
description:
About Datacom
  
With over 6,200 people, and centre’s of technical excellence spread across Australasia, Datacom is committed to developing and growing its capability across Asia. Founded in 1965 in New Zealand, and with over 2 decades of operating in Malaysia and the Philippines, Datacom has experienced expediential growth. Through all this, Datacom has maintained high levels of profitability with a track record of delivering innovative, cost effective digital and technology solutions, all delivered by dynamic teams spread across various locations. Our people are the best in their fields – smart, passionate, and dedicated to providing exceptional IT services to our customers. This makes for a rewarding and fast\-paced place to work.
  
Our purpose
  
Here at Datacom we connect people and technology in order to solve challenges, create opportunities and discover new possibilities for the communities we live in.
  
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic and innovative AI Quality Assurance Lead who is passionate about the latest developments in AI and machine learning. This role will focus on creating AI\-driven QA solutions, adopting cutting\-edge AI advancements, and ensuring the quality and reliability of AI\-based systems. With over 5 years of experience in test automation across a wide range of tools, the ideal candidate will be proactive in adopting new technologies, ensuring the robustness and accuracy of AI models, and driving the quality agenda within the organization.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* AI QA Solutions Development: Design, develop, and implement advanced AI\-powered QA automation solutions for testing AI\-based applications, models, and systems. Use innovative techniques to identify performance bottlenecks, inconsistencies, and model biases.
* Test Automation \& Frameworks: Build and maintain automated test frameworks for AI systems using a wide variety of automation tools (e.g., Playwright, Appium, pytest, or custom\-built AI testing tools). Ensure that test automation strategies are scalable, reusable, and aligned with industry best practices. Senior test automation coding skills in at least one of the following languages: python, typescript, java, C\#.
* AI Model Testing: Perform functional and non\-functional testing of AI models to assess accuracy, bias, scalability, and robustness. Conduct regression testing and ensure that AI solutions behave as expected across different scenarios.
* Adopt AI Innovations: Stay up to date with the latest AI advancements and research. Actively explore and adopt emerging AI technologies (e.g., GPT models, neural networks, reinforcement learning) to continuously improve the quality assurance process.
* Cloud and On\-Premise AI Services: Test and validate AI solutions hosted on both cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on\-premise AI services. Ensure that the AI solutions perform optimally across both environments.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI developers, data scientists, and product teams to identify testing requirements, troubleshoot issues, and improve overall AI system quality. Provide feedback and insights on AI solution design from a QA perspective.

description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
   

  

 The Promotional Media Measurement and Operations Data Science team (part of Netflix’s Data Science and Engineering organization) analyzes, conducts research on and develops metrics about the relationship between promotional media (artwork, trailers, synopses) and member engagement, to ultimately influence the creation and deployment of titles’ promotional assets. As Netflix continues to innovate, new content experiences and formats are being introduced and optimized, including Live, Games, Mobile, and more. We call these “Emerging Experiences”. This in turn creates new challenges and opportunities to reimagine the role of promotional media in these new domains and how we should understand, measure and improve performance.
   

  

 We are looking for a talented and experienced senior data scientist to become a thought leader in these exciting new spaces. This role will require a blend of strong technical skills and methodological knowledge combined with equally strong communication skills, creative thinking and stakeholder and project management, all ultimately in service of finding the best outcomes for Netflix’s members and business. Interested? Read more about the job description and qualifications below!
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with a diverse range of cross\-functional business partners to understand Emerging Experiences at Netflix and what the role of promotional media is (or should be) in those domains
* Conduct exploratory analysis to build the conceptual frameworks for how we should think about these new content types / formats and capture how members are currently interacting with them and how they may do so in the future
* Execute and analyze experiments and/or develop causal inference and machine learning models to identify key drivers of positive member outcomes that can be attributed to promotional assets
* Develop metrics and models to guide partners on promotional asset creation and deployment in the Emerging Experiences area
* Coordinate and communicate often and effectively with both stakeholders and fellow data scientists and analytics engineers to build shared knowledge and execute in a fast\-paced and fluid environment
* Serve as a key thought partner for leaders in the space

* Expertise in statistical methods, notably regression analysis, forecasting, causal inference, and experimentation
* Highly proficient programming in SQL and Python / R

* Exceptional written and oral communication with technical and non\-technical audiences
* Enthusiasm about and compatibility with Netflix culture

**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 


**About the Team** 

 At Roku, data is at the center of everything we do. Our passion for data has made us a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.  We are looking for a Data Scientist to drive forecasting, reporting, and analyzing for Roku’s Key Performance Metrics (KPMs).  Streaming Hours and other engagement metrics are used by senior leadership to understand our user base health, develop financial forecasts and make strategic decisions.  The role is part of a team that works closely with finance and other executive members to support corporate strategy and serve as a trusted advisor by leaders across the organization.
 



  
 


**About the Role** 

 The person in this role will leverage their business acumen and love of data to provide business insights that are relevant and digestible to key decision makers at Roku.  The role requires both high technical aptitude and problem\-solving abilities, motivation, and exceptional attention to detail.  The successful candidate will display a balance of hard and soft skills, including the ability to respond quickly to changing business needs.
 



 For California Only \- The estimated annual salary for this position is between $86,000\-$166,000 annually.  Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.  This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.
 



 Roku will be accepting applications for this position until October 27, 2025 \[or until the position filled].
 



  
 


**What You'll Be Doing** 
* Support the analytical needs of the finance team and executive leadership, inclusive of business performance reporting, ad hoc analysis, statistical inference and predictive modeling for Roku's KPMs
* Provide analytical support and monitor key performance indicators, highlighting trends and analyzing causes of changes. Conduct deep dives when observing abnormal trends and identify potential risks before they manifest
* Understand drivers of value creation to guide strategic and financial planning
* Leverage Roku's vast amounts of data to generate business insights that inform strategy at the highest levels of leadership
* Ensure accuracy of key performance metrics before they are released both internally and externally
* Deliver presentations to clearly and effectively communicate findings to stakeholders



  
 


**We’re excited if you have** 
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in a quantitative field (e.g. data scientist, analyst, technical consulting) in technology, e\-commerce, or finance
* Excellent command of SQL and experience working with Big Data
* Proficient in Excel
* Experience in R or Python
* Experience with data visualization platform like Tableau, Looker, etc
* Statistics knowledge: A/B testing, statistical inference, interpretation of data, etc.
* Strong communication skills across verbal, written, and presentations
* Academic background in math, physics, computer science, economics, engineering

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Our employees can take time off work for vacation and other personal reasons to balance their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**The Roku Culture** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.

 : Competitive comp plus meaningful equity in a company defining a new medical specialty.

We have become a multibillion\-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future.

* Ability to infer useful forward\-looking directions from results of retrospective analysis

* Ability to refine requirements from ambiguous requests to produce reports demonstrating excellence in communication

**Preferred**
* Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline

The power of Data Science and AI is only as good as the problems it solves. Your purpose is to help build and scale Squarcle’s Data Science capability. You’ll help shape cutting\-edge internal products within our AI Labs, and you’ll be delivering high\-impact AI solutions for clients across complex industries like defence, construction, and nuclear.

  


**Our structure**



At Squarcle, we work in a matrix structure designed to support your growth and success. You’ll have a **Performance Manager** to guide your career development, an **Engagement Manager** to support your day\-to\-day project work, and a **Capability Lead** to ensure best practice across tools, people, and processes. This role sits within our Digital Capability, where you’ll work closely with **Jade O’Leary**, our **Senior Manager \- Data Science**, and report into one of our Engagement Directors. Your Performance Manager and project assignment will be confirmed once your first engagement is agreed.

 **This is what you’ll be doing**



As a Data Science Consultant within our Digital capability you’ll be joining us as we build momentum. This means there’s room for people to shape how we grow, not just keep up with it. Some of your key day to day activities will include:


* While on engagement you will work closely with customers to understand their challenges and translate these into clear, actionable tasks
* You’ll  

design and deliver data science solutions, regularly reporting back to the customer to make sure it meets their requirements and algins to their expectations
* Work collaboratively with other data experts and domain specialists to share knowledge, develop best practices, and align technology with business objectives
* Often, you’ll be developing and/or deploying solutions in customer infrastructure which may have strict security controls
* When not on engagement, you’ll  

contribute to internal innovation efforts including helping us build our AI Labs capability and support business development through technical input to assist us in winning new engagements

  


**We’ll continue develop and measure your success in the following areas**



Each engagement will have a set of deliverables which you will be responsible for. We’ll measure your success in the following areas:


* Engagement Manager, client and peer feedback
* Ability to work through complex problems with a positive solution focused mindset
* Working with your Performance Manager to create and set measurable goals

  


**Where you’ll be stretched (and thrive)**


* **Challenging AI proposals:** you’ll be working through some complex AI workflows and deploying them into classified systems
* **You'll often be the dedicated Data Scientist on a project:** you’ll have the autonomy and ownership to lead the data science agenda alongside a supportive Squarcle team
* **Consulting isn’t always smooth sailing:** Client needs evolve, projects pivot, and ambiguity is part of the job. You’ll need to be adaptable, calm under pressure, and comfortable navigating change

  


**We think you’ll love**


* **Shape the future:** you’ll have the opportunity to leave your mark by building and scaling Squarcle’s Data Science capability. Help us define what great looks like for years to come
* **Room to innovate:** with a dedicated AI budget and full backing for our internal AI Labs, you’ll have the space, time, and resources to push boundaries and experiment with new ideas
* **Best of both worlds:** this hybrid role gives you the variety of client\-facing work with the deeper satisfaction of shaping in\-house AI products that we own, evolve, and stand behind.
  


This isn’t just another consulting role. It’s a chance to be part of something growing, ambitious, and meaningful.

* **Hands\-on machine learning experience:** including techniques such as classification, clustering, and deep learning
* **Cloud development experience:** ideally with Azure, but AWS or GCP also valuable

Our interview process for this role will involve two steps:


**Step 1:** Meet with our Recruitment Manager, Corina. She’ll introduce you to Squarcle, the role, and answer any questions you may have about us. We’ll be assessing some basic skills for the role and finding out more about your background.


**Step 2:** Meet with our Senior Manager – Data Science, Jade and Senior Advisor for AI, Rob. They’ll deep dive into the role and your capabilities.

  


**What we offer**

* Generous leave package
	+ 26 days of annual leave (including your birthday!) plus UK bank holidays — increasing to 27 days after three years, and 28 after seven years
	+ You’ll also get five extra days for your five and 10 year anniversaries

Research Associate in Fuel Cell Systems
**About the role**
------------------


This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of cutting edge\-research in aerospace propulsion as part of IAAPS \- a world\-leading research centre driving innovation in clean propulsion and mobility. As part of the University of Bath’s commitment to engineering net zero, you’ll contribute to transformative research in fuel cell systems helping shape the future of sustainable transport.


You will be joining an expert team to work on the digital twin of a hydrogen electric aircraft propulsion system as part of a government funded project in collaboration with a leading industrial partner. The role will involve regular working on\-site with the industrial partner who is located around 30 miles from the university.


As a key member of the project team, you will:

* **Develop and refine simulation models** of aircraft propulsion systems using 1D and 3D tools to capture thermal, fluid, and performance behaviour.
* **Apply AI and machine learning techniques** (e.g. LSTM, k\-means, reinforcement learning, Bayesian inference) for tasks such as parameter estimation, fault diagnostics, and remaining useful life (RUL) prediction.
* **Design and implement a hybrid digital twin architecture**, integrating physics\-based models with real\-time sensor data and AI components.
* **Validate models and AI predictions** against test data to ensure accuracy, robustness, and regulatory compliance for aerospace applications.
* **Collaborate across disciplines** with engineers, data scientists, and industry partners to co\-develop solutions aligned with UK aerospace innovation priorities.
* **Disseminate findings** through high\-quality technical reports, academic publications, and presentations at national and international events.


As a member of Research Staff at the University of Bath, you will be encouraged to take up a minimum of 10 days professional development pro rata per year.

description:

 Babylist is the leading registry, e\-commerce, and content platform for growing families. More than 9 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, trusted guidance, and expert product recommendations for new parents and the people who love them. We're helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step. As we build the generational brand in baby, our mission remains simple: to connect growing families with everything they need to thrive.To learn more, visit www.babylist.com.
   

  

**Our Ways of Working**
 Babylist thrives as a remote\-first company, with HQ team members located across the U.S. and Canada. **What the Role Is**

 **Senior Data Scientist**

You'll be the dedicated data science expert responsible for maintaining and iterating on our core predictive models, while developing new modeling capabilities that will scale with our growing organization.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, business\-critical role where your work will directly support financial projections and future growth strategies. You'll operate as the sole dedicated data scientist initially, working closely with business analysts, marketing teams, and cross\-functional partners to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business insights.
   

  

 As our first dedicated modeling expert, you'll have the unique opportunity to set best practices, influence strategic decisions, and build the foundation for our expanding data science capabilities during an exciting growth period at Babylist.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 5\+ years of experience in data science or a related field, with a proven track record of developing and deploying models that drive business impact
* You have hands\-on experience building and maintaining decision\-support models such as customer lifetime value, conversion prediction models, and retention forecasting that have influenced real business decisions
* You are able to break down complex technical concepts into simple, actionable insights for executives and non\-technical partners to enable confident decision\-making
* You have a strong track record of prioritizing projects based on business impact with clear communication of tradeoffs, outcomes, and value to leadership
* You are highly skilled in SQL, comfortable working across large\-scale datasets, writing complex queries, and uncovering insights that drive strategy
* You have programming expertise in Python or R with experience in statistical modeling, data manipulation, and advanced analytics
* You have experience with orchestration and deployment tools like Airflow to deliver reliable, production\-ready models that scale
* You have a background in dynamic pricing and promotion modeling, applying advanced methods to optimize strategy and outcomes
* You have developed decision\-support models that inform internal business strategy and operations rather than solely external\-facing product features
* You are adept at spotting high\-impact modeling opportunities, securing stakeholder buy\-in, and delivering solutions end\-to\-end that drive measurable value
* You are flexible and curious, contributing beyond model development to the broader analytics landscape
* You are confident working independently while managing strong cross\-functional relationships across multiple teams


**How You Will Make An Impact**
* You'll own the paid conversion model, stabilizing and improving its accuracy and performance to better predict which signups become paying customers
* You'll lead the deployment of LTV V1 into production, ensuring reliability and scalability
* You'll establish and champion modeling best practices across the organization to raise the standard of data science
* You'll build strong relationships with cross\-functional stakeholders and demonstrate measurable business impact
* You will drive the development of new modeling initiatives, including the evolution of the LTV model and other decision\-support tools
* You'll shape business strategy by delivering actionable, data\-driven insights and recommendations to leadership
* You'll scale modeling capabilities as the organization grows, including mentoring and developing future team members
* You'll partner with leadership on ambitious growth projections and strategic planning efforts
* You'll lay the foundation for expanded data science capabilities across a wide range of business functions


**Why You Will Love Working At Babylist**
* We invest in the infrastructure you'll need to be supported and successful: tools, opportunities to connect with colleagues, and a stipend to help you set up your office
* We build products that have a positive impact on millions of people's lives
* We work at a sustainable pace which means work/life balance is a real thing here
* We believe technology and data can solve hard problems
* AI plays a meaningful role in how we work, create, and scale—intentionally embedded in our tools, systems, and decision\-making to support innovation and real impact
* We believe in exceptional management
* We offer competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement
* We have great benefits like company paid medical, dental, and vision, a generous paid parental leave policy, and 401k with company match
* We care about employee wellbeing with perks for physical, mental and emotional health, parenting, childcare, and financial planning


 Babylist follows a market\-based approach to compensation, with pay varying based on location, experience, and qualifications. In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, the
 **starting salary range** 
 for this role is
 **$166,207\.00 to $199,407\.00** 
 , representing the lowest to highest compensation we reasonably expect to offer for this position.
   

  

 Your starting salary within this range will be determined based on your skills, experience, and work location, with future adjustments informed by role growth, performance, and internal pay equity. Babylist is committed to supporting career progression and recognizes the value of performance\-based advancement.
   

  

 In addition to competitive pay, Babylist offers equity, bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package, including company\-paid health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) matching, flexible spending accounts, and paid leave, including PTO and parental leave.
   

  

**Important Notices**

**SMS Consent**

 **STOP**
